title: Expose Your App: DNS, LB, TLS Steps

scenes.line1: How do you safely expose an app?
scenes.say: How do you actually expose a new app to users? Let's walk through the real steps, so you never miss a detail.

scenes.label: Cert
scenes.sub: Create a certificate request with all hostnames.
scenes.say: First, request a certificate. Include every hostname your app will use, like production and internal names.

rows.b: Set up on the load balancer

scenes.say: Next, build out your load balancer. Create the listener, add your app servers to the backend pool, and set up a health probe to check the health endpoint.

scenes.title: Test Before DNS
scenes.say: Before you touch DNS, test the VIP directly using the real hostname. This makes sure your cert and backend are working before users ever hit the app.

scenes.question: When should you update DNS?
scenes.wrong: Right after setting up the load balancer
scenes.right: Only after you test the VIP directly and confirm it's healthy
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: don't update DNS until you've tested the VIP directly and confirmed everything is healthy.
